question: In a certain code language, 'SILK' is written as 'TIML' and 'INSECT' is written as 'IOTEDU'. How will 'CHANGE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

​'SILK' is written as 'TIML'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95b7d08d6a6916e5eea388890b4dc62d7379a129e278749cdd3f72453a5f7b90.png] 

And,

'INSECT' is written as 'IOTEDU'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ce41fb96218a06cf6381aa948ca410489515590ef1788e41468b1f51778d59ec.png] 

Similarly,

'CHANGE' will be written as

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/68a8c28d6577a00ec281ce2ea8be289773206bfcbeccaee6645053ac673f302c.png] 

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
